_about: Fixed inputs and expected outputs for the published files. Run with `node verify.mjs` after `npm install`. Pinned dependency versions are in package.json, so a disagreement here is about the cryptography rather than about which library version happened to be installed.
_generated: Computed by running the published source, not written by hand.

kdf._about: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256, 600,000 iterations, 16-byte salt. The expected keys below are the full 32-byte output in hex.

accepts.label: upper-case hex salt, same key as lower case

refuses.label: a non-hex salt
refuses._why: Buffer.from(_, 'hex') used to truncate this to zero bytes and derive a key from nothing.

refuses.label: a non-hex salt of different text
refuses._why: Decoded to the same zero bytes as the one above, so two different wrong salts derived the IDENTICAL key.

refuses.label: a valid hex prefix followed by junk

envelope._about: Round trips and refusals are checked against envelopes verify.mjs seals at run time, because a GCM envelope embeds a random IV and a fixed one would only test one nonce.

logLeak._about: A decrypt that succeeds cryptographically but yields invalid JSON. The marker must not appear in any log line; a fixed failure code must.
